rationale: A normal interior MoE layer with a full indexer refresh, in the last complete 8,192-token chunk. Chosen by structure and existing raw-trace review, not by speed; this is one invocation, not a statistical average.
grouping_note: The model tree partitions all 45 selected events once. The original RoPE family is split into its two source-reviewed invocations. All 41 original family work/metric objects and 28 original joins are preserved; a separately pinned overlay supplies matrix-scope classification and selected scalar/useful-byte estimates. Semantic grouping does not establish serialization or a dependency DAG.
limitations: This index-refresh example does not represent index-reuse layers, the dense first layer, the padded final chunk, draft work or PP communication.
Layer ownership is reviewed source-order inference after runtime/forward correlation. Nsight warned that some records might be missing.

The original ledger retains 28 work/byte joins. Separate source-reviewed classification covers all 41 families for matrix work in these 45 captured events; scalar and byte coverage remain partial. Physical DRAM MBU was not measured in the original capture; the separate GPU4 replay is reported in the Physical memory section.
Useful-byte MBU is an interface estimate, not measured DRAM traffic. Cache/on-chip reuse can make it exceed 100%; values are not clipped.
